name: NuoliHealth Biotech MCP
description: Agent-facing MCP tool surface for CRO/CDMO discovery, assay routing, and preclinical experiment preparation.

tools.name: biotech.classify_request
tools.description: Classify a biotech request by disease area, modality, discovery stage, assay type, study type, and provider category.

tools.name: experiment.route
tools.description: Route an AI-generated hypothesis or development need to the appropriate experimental workflow, such as in vitro assay, in vivo model, ADME/DMPK, toxicology, formulation, CMC, or CDMO execution.

tools.name: provider.search
tools.description: Search CRO and CDMO providers by capability, assay type, disease area, modality, geography, certification, turnaround, and project stage.

tools.name: provider.compare
tools.description: Compare CRO/CDMO providers across scientific fit, operational fit, capabilities, responsiveness, and project stage.

tools.name: provider.match
tools.description: Match a scoped biotech project to likely CRO/CDMO providers.

tools.name: assay.search
tools.description: Search assay and study types relevant to a target, compound, modality, mechanism, endpoint, or disease area.

tools.name: experiment.prepare
tools.description: Prepare a structured experiment work packet for CRO/CDMO intake.

tools.name: rfq.prepare
tools.description: Prepare an RFQ package for external CRO/CDMO execution.
